description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to property of intestate, Watareka, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership issues, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
